daemon_hostname.description: IP address for the daemon's HTTP listener to bind to.

daemon_port.description: TCP port for the daemon's HTTP listener.

pdus.description: List of PDU devices to control. Each entry defines one physical or logical PDU. Note: 'pdudaemon' uses a flat JSON object (not list) for [pdus] section, so each PDU is keyed by its name. Each item should be a dict with PDU-specific options (e.g., 'driver', 'host', etc.). See 'sample_values' for structure and supported keys per driver type.

aliases.description: List of PDU aliases. Each alias maps a logical name to a specific PDU name and outlet index. Each item has 'name', 'hostname', and 'port'.
